title: K428 Daily Reinvest Implementation (AUM Tracking + 8% Cash Buffer + PT1 Safety Valve)
basis: K428 S1 finding: daily reinvest @ $10M AUM → +$3.6M / 5y vs static sizing

pt1_safety_valve.rationale: Essentially free per K428 — v6.13d mean 0.03%/day → 7d≈0.21%, fires ~1-2x/yr at 5% threshold

integration.K280_primary: updates AUM + runs PT1 check (first daemon each day)
integration.K302a_secondary: updates AUM with K297' PnL (no PT1 check)
integration.K344_secondary: updates AUM with sUSDe yield contribution
integration.K376_tertiary: reads K376 sleeve target from state (paper-trade; no PnL update)
integration.emergency_exit: reads AUM state for deployed_capital context in pre-check
integration.additive: all production scripts continue working without K429 if AUM_TRACKING_ENABLED=False

compounding_projection.note: vs static: linear 10.9%/yr × N years; compounding advantage grows as AUM grows

html_updates.banner: K429 daily reinvest LIVE: AUM tracking $X.XM, cumulative +Y.Y% (PT1 safety ON/OFF)
html_updates.widget: Portfolio AUM card with live metrics from data/portfolio_aum_state.json

test_plan: python3 scripts/portfolio_aum_manager.py --check-pt1 → verify PT1 does not fire at +0.05%
python3 scripts/portfolio_aum_manager.py --status → verify sleeve allocations correct
AUM_TRACKING_ENABLED=False python3 scripts/k280_daily_run.py → verify graceful skip
